title: Nutty Mexican Chocolate Empanadas
description: A cozy Mexican dish featuring dark chocolate chips and herbal notes, perfect for a cold evening. This recipe incorporates ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients for a balanced treat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cinnamon, anise seeds, and salt.
Add the beaten egg, milk, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of dark chocolate chips and a sprinkle of chopped walnuts in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
Submerge the empanadas in an ice bath for 30 seconds to stop the cooking process.
